name: internet-change-detector
description: The Internet Change Detector - continuous monitoring, verifiable snapshots and shareable change events for public web pages.

scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute changedetector --local --file=./seed/sites.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:sql && wrangler d1 execute changedetector --remote --file=./seed/sites.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
